A slow travel guide to scenic stops by train

The line runs along the coast for most of its length, and the stations are close enough together that you can stop at three of them in one day without rushing. Trains run every hour in winter.

The first stop is a harbour town with a market on Saturdays. From the station it is a five minute walk to the water, and the cafe by the lifeboat station opens at eight in the morning.

The second stop is a castle that is open all year. The walk from the platform takes twenty minutes, and the path is flat enough for a pushchair for most of the way.
